author: Inside Edition
description: With much of the country blanketed with snow, many people went sledding. One viral stunt is hooking a sled to a car and getting hauled around at high speed through snowy streets. The stunt left one Texas family heartbroken. Elizabeth Angle, 16, was riding in a sled with a friend behind a Jeep when the sled hit a curb and the teens were catapulted. Angle was killed and her friend is in the ICU. Every year, 25,000 kids and adults end up in the emergency room after sledding accidents.
title: 16-Year-Old Girl Dies After Sledding Accident

author: Inside Edition
description: Hundreds of motorists were caught in the winter storm and are now sharing their ordeal from behind the wheel. Alysa Jones and her fiance Devan Allen were stuck for 17 hours. With no place to go, they passed the time watching the animated movie "Shark Tale" on their phone. As the hours went on, they realized they would be there for the night. They had enough gas to stay warm, but other drivers didn't.
title: Couple Stuck In Car For 17 Hours During Winter Storm

author: Inside Edition
description: Utah children who were allegedly abducted by their "Doomsday Mom" have been found. The four missing children were last seen with their mom, Elleshia Seymor, corralling the kids onto a plane bound for Amsterdam. Now, two months later, the 35-year-old mom has been arrested in Croatia after the kids were discovered in a state-run orphanage. Before fleeing the country, Seymour described her bleak visions of an apocalyptic end to life in a series of TikTok videos.
title: 4 Missing Children Allegedly Abducted By 'Doomsday Mom' Found

author: Inside Edition
description: A pizza delivery man approached a house during Sunday's snow storm and waited for the customer to open the door. The delivery man looked at the signed receipt and saw that there was not one penny left for a tip. The delivery man went back to his car with the pizza and told the homeowner to grab the pizza from the store. The customer in Maryland says it was a misunderstanding and was going to give a cash tip. Dominoes did not respond to Inside Edition's request for comment.
title: Pizza Delivery Man Stuns Homeowner After Receipt Shows No Tip

author: Inside Edition
description: Protesters mocked Border Patrol Commander Greg Bovino outside his hotel as news broke that he has been booted out of Minneapolis by order of President Donald Trump. Published reports say that Bovino has been demoted and ordered to return to his home base in California. Trump is said to be unhappy that Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem said slain Alex Pretti was out to kill law enforcement, a depiction that does not match videos shot by bystanders.
title: Minneapolis Protestors Mock ICE Chief Greg Bovino After Demotion

author: Inside Edition
description: Sydney Sweeney is launching her own lingerie line called Syrn. The actress says the brand was inspired by her personal struggle to find a good bra. Her line is financially backed by Amazon founder Jeff Bezos, who is said to be the second wealthiest man in the world. The undergarments come in 44 sizes and cost less than $100. Over the weekend, Sweeney promoted the brand by climbing the world-famous Hollywood sign.
title: Sydney Sweeney Launches Syrn, Her 44-Size Lingerie Line

author: Inside Edition
description: In 1996, our sister show American Journal captured the great fashion designer Valentino as he prepped his New York boutique for its grand opening. With his signature charm and wit, the legendary Italian designer quipped to AJ correspondent, Karen Duffy, " Why are you wearing sneakers?” He then challenged the American public to dress better, and spoke of how New York City influenced his work. The fabled fashionisto passed away last week at the age of 93.
title: Valentino in 1996: "Why Are You Wearing Sneakers?"

author: Inside Edition
description: The New York City Metropolitan Transit Authority (MTA) hopes that new, physical barriers like spikes and paddles on subway turnstiles will deter fare evaders, but we found plenty of folks ducking the turnstiles at those stations. And the MTA has worked with contractors to provide new, plexiglass doors to try and crack down even further. But influencers like King Spider, who says he skips the fare to “strike” against bad service and crime, have found new ways to slide right on through.
title: Can Anything Stop New York Subway Fare Evaders?

author: Inside Edition
description: This train got a one-way ticket into the Guinness Book of World Records. The world's longest chocolate train was unveiled in Milan, Italy. It measures in at 55.27 meters, or 181 feet, long and it weighs 2,300 kilos, or more than 5,000 pounds. The train was designed by master pastry chefs in Italy and Malta, who also involved their students. Unfortunately, reports say the chocolate isn't safe to eat because it's been exposed to so many elements. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: World's Longest Chocolate Train Unveiled In Italy

author: Inside Edition
description: The entire student body at Jones High School in Orlando is getting free tuition to nearby Valencia College. School board member Vicki-Elaine Felder delivered the news to the students in the gymnasium. Senior Jaeda Anthony is one of the lucky students. Anthony says one of the most stressful things about applying to colleges is how you are going to pay for it. "And now with this full-ride scholarship that weight is completely taken off of our shoulders," Anthony says.
title: Student Body At This High School Gets Free Tuition To Nearby College
